mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks from -38.7 to -31.9, showing the reopening impulse is still dominant; this momentum persists so next 4-week mean exceeds last 4-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days despite the three-week improving trend.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovery from -39.1 to -21.7 crosses above -25, signaling outdoor social activity normalization, which raises discretionary retail footfall.
failure_condition: When PARKS is above -25 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stagnates below -40 for three weeks, indicating commuting remains suppressed; without transit recovery, retail footfall loses a key support and declines.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean stays <= -40 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT <= -40 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Last week WORKPLACES fell to -29.0 while RESIDENTIAL rose to 14.1, showing a shift back to home-based work; this reduces weekday office-district retail and pulls RETAIL_REC lower.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by >=4 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL rises by >=1 point
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES falls >=4 points and RESIDENTIAL rises >=1 point, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM is much less depressed than RETAIL_REC; when grocery/pharmacy mobility stabilizes above -9, it signals resilient essential spending and predicts catch-up discretionary retail spending.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > -9, RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is lower than last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In the reopening regime defined by PARKS improving and TRANSIT no longer falling, retail recovers as restrictions ease; this regime predicts higher RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves >5 points over two weeks and TRANSIT does not fall below -45
failure_condition: In weeks when PARKS improves >5 points and TRANSIT stabilizes, RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is lower than last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Late February/early March seasonal normalisation after summer holidays lifts retail footfall, independent of pandemic restrictions.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days despite the seasonal post-holiday window.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL at or above +14 indicates elevated stay-at-home behavior, which crowds out retail trips; when residential mobility stays high, RETAIL_REC declines.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL >=14.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the last 7 days.
